{{PRODUCT_ENTRIES}}## Assumption Drift & Policy Audit Pilot — $299
One integration, up to ten documented business rules, private evidence report; synthetic or sanitized inputs only. Scope review required; no live credentials. A free fictional contract check illustrates how passing tests can miss a rule mismatch.
